# Tradevithika

> India's B2B textiles and apparel export marketplace connecting verified Indian manufacturers with global buyers. Source fabrics, garments, and home textiles with trust and transparency.

Tradevithika focuses exclusively on the textiles and apparel sector, offering verified supplier profiles, RFQs, custom quotes, secure messaging, and an export toolkit (Incoterms, HS codes, cost calculator, compliance).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Platform overview and featured categories.
- [Products](/products): Browse textiles and apparel from verified Indian suppliers.
- [Categories](/categories): Product categories across fabrics, garments, and home textiles.
- [Suppliers](/suppliers): Directory of verified Indian textile and apparel manufacturers.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide for buyers and suppliers.
- [About](/about): About Tradevithika.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on Indian textile exports, trade compliance, and sourcing.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/login): Buyer, supplier, and admin login.
- [Register](/register): Create a buyer or supplier account.
